parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the protection rule template whose configurations you want to modify.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou:** the Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1:** outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection rule template whose configurations you want to modify.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The name of the protection rule template whose configurations you want to modify.
